name: core-research-deploy

implementer.summary: Implement only what is selected. Do not invent installs. Live skills are available; inventory skills need install or research first. Prefer existing Atlas routes for verification.
rules: Never claim a skill is installed unless status is live or workspace.
Plugins are local catalog packs until grok plugin install succeeds.
Connectors require the user's linked account; use search_connected_tools first.
HTTP services listed must return JSON; UI must call them with working buttons.
Export this package as the source of truth for the build tranche.
Auth stays off unless the product ask names accounts/login/per-user data.
steps: 2. Scaffold or extend the Atlas routes needed by selected services.
3. Wire UI selectors/pins for selected skills and plugins.
4. Run typecheck, build, browser-smoke, agent-browser on critical buttons.
5. Write encyclopedia note of what was selected and verified.

items.name: agent-orchestration
items.purpose: Routes a task across named agents with a single owner and a written handoff.
items.implement: Load SKILL.md for `agent-orchestration` from server-skills; wire triggers: multi-agent, team, delegate.

items.name: archivist
items.purpose: Clinical 200-search mode: cite, separate claim from source, stop when the tranche repeats.
items.implement: Load SKILL.md for `archivist` from server-skills; wire triggers: archivist, 200-search, batch.

items.name: deploy-everything
items.purpose: Frontend, GitHub, and the Vercel file-deploy path with an honest scope check.
items.implement: Treat as local plugin pack `deploy-everything`; catalog entry, not marketplace install unless grok plugin list confirms.

items.name: web_search
items.purpose: Search the public web for facts and sources.
items.implement: Call tool `web_search` only when the next fact or action requires it; log inputs/outputs.

items.name: Deployment package selector
items.purpose: Pick skills/tools/plugins and export LLM-ready package JSON.
items.implement: Enter mode `Deployment package selector`: Pick skills/tools/plugins and export LLM-ready package JSON.

items.name: POST /api/package
items.purpose: Build structured deployment package from selection.
items.implement: Expose or call HTTP surface `POST /api/package` with JSON, no-store cache.

verification: curl /health returns ok and skill counts
curl /api/inventory returns total matching selection universe
POST /api/package with body {ids:[...]} returns schema atlas.deploymentPackage.v1
Selector page toggles, presets, copy package, download package
npm run typecheck && npm run build
browser-smoke clean console; agent-browser filter + service probe
